en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square or broad street intersection lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings in a German town. In the foreground three women in long dresses and aprons stand talking, while another figure walks by carrying a large load. On the left is a tree‑lined street; in the center a fenced circular or oval planting with trees and a tall empty flagpole; at the back several ornate townhouses and commercial buildings. A corner building at right bears a wall sign reading "Preussischer …", and across the square a large sign on the prominent corner building reads "Warenhaus Robert Lindt."
